d: A celestial humanoid entity with a youthful but serene face, featuring almond-shaped eyes of a glowing golden-yellow hue. The head is adorned with a massive, ornate golden headdress resembling stylized wings and a crown, with long, flowing ribbons of gold extending from the sides. The body is slender and encased in a white and gold armored suit, characterized by large, sweeping golden wing-like structures emanating from the back and shoulders, with two floating golden swords positioned symmetrically. BODY COLOR: Pale ivory and gold LEGS: Plantigrade, encased in sleek white and gold armored boots.
